scope: Prospective robot-inertia capacity estimate, not native-force replay or executed control
held_finger_approximation: Compiled right6arm M_aa includes downstream arm/finger inertias at actual archived configurations. Off-arm finger accelerations are held at zero in this subblock approximation; native pad/jaw compliance dynamics are not solved. Bolt/free-object inertia is not added to the robot mass matrix.
timing: Saved post-q state t matches retained geometry for original command labelt+2dt; qvel/J velocity geometry is at the saved post-state time. Original contact force timing remains separatelylabel minusdt. No unsampled state interpolation or solver history reconstruction.
terms: Hybrid5 rows:2transverse translations plus3rotations. Scheduled orbital tangential/centripetal acceleration and yawalpha only; axial translation row excluded. Bias/damping/Jdot and calibration Cdot/pdot are not reestimated.
unit_scope: Lambda5 translational block kg; translation/rotation blocks kg*m; rotational block kg*m^2. a5 first2 m/s^2,last3 rad/s^2; wrench first2N,last3Nm.
force_caps_scope: FF-alone is below8N/2Nm at19sampled poses, but adding it to already lagging archived PD reaches10.161N/2.325Nm. Any physical candidate must apply the original combined8N/2Nm and native motor caps; new PD history will differ. This does not predict full-curve/native tracking or prove the sole cause of radial drift.
